meaning: The Model evaluated by this benchmark.
The wallet that published this receipt-backed benchmark and paid its rent.
Benchmark slug, 1 to 32 bytes: lowercase letters and digits in groups joined by single hyphens.
The model's `effective_version()` at the slot the benchmark was published.
32-byte SHA-256 hash of the evaluation dataset.
Dataset location URI (`https://`, `http://`, `ipfs://`, or `hf://`), 1 to 160 bytes with no whitespace or control characters.
Score in basis points, enforced on chain to equal `floor(passed_count * 10_000 / sample_count)`.
1 to 16 unique canonical `Receipt` PDA addresses verified on chain against `model` during `publish_benchmark`.
The slot the benchmark was published in.
